reproduction.runner:
import subprocess,json,statistics,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/birnam-iteration-simplify');runs=[]
binary='/tmp/birnam-range-handlers/prefix-v2/bin/birnam'
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('BIRNAM_','DYLD_','BENCH_HOST_'))}
for variant in ['baseline','shared','shared','baseline']:
    p=subprocess.run([binary,str(root/(variant+'-aot-bench.birnam'))],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,check=True)
    assert not p.stderr,p.stderr
    rows=json.loads(p.stdout)
    assert len(rows)==3 and all(r['size']==200 and len(r['cpu_ns'])==3 for r in rows),p.stdout
    runs.append(dict(variant=variant,rows=rows))
    print(variant,[(r['phase'],round(statistics.median(r['cpu_ns'])/1e6,3)) for r in rows],flush=True)
summary={}
for phase in ['vector_do','vector_collect','range_do']:
    medians={v:statistics.median([n for run in runs if run['variant']==v for r in run['rows'] if r['phase']==phase for n in r['cpu_ns']]) for v in ['baseline','shared']}
    summary[phase]=dict(baseline_median_ns=medians['baseline'],candidate_median_ns=medians['shared'],reduction_percent=(1-medians['shared']/medians['baseline'])*100)
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
(root/'final-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(binary=binary,runs=runs,summary=summary),indent=2)+'\n')
